description: Every environment variable Rank reads, where it is consumed, and what breaks without it. Cross-checked against convex/convex.config.ts and the code by `pnpm check:env`.

vars.name: CLERK_JWT_ISSUER
vars.purpose: Clerk issuer URL. Validated by Convex separately from the app env table; without it there are no authenticated callers.

vars.name: CLERK_JWT_AUDIENCE
vars.purpose: Must match the Clerk JWT template's audience. The template is named `convex`.

vars.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Required by convex.config.ts, so codegen and deploy fail without it. Reads brand and candidate pages.

vars.name: FIRECRAWL_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.purpose: Verifies crawl completion callbacks. New crawls default to webhook mode (convex/firecrawl.ts), so unset means unverified callbacks. Use poll mode or set it.

vars.name: NEBIUS_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Absent, the rerank records status `skipped` with the reason 'NEBIUS_API_KEY is not set' and candidates keep discovery order. This is the last credential the ranking slice needs.

vars.name: DEFAULT_RANK_MODEL
vars.purpose: Cross-encoder model id used when a call does not name one.

vars.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Absent, the evaluator constructor throws 'TYPESAFE_API_KEY is required' and the judgment stage fails closed. No candidate is auto-judged without it.

vars.name: TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL
vars.purpose: System One model id. The code default is already jev-latest, so setting it is explicit rather than required.

vars.name: TELNYX_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Telnyx v2 API key. Not part of the ranking slice.

vars.name: TELNYX_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.purpose: Base64 Ed25519 public key. Without it /telnyx/webhook fails closed and returns 401.

vars.name: TELNYX_FROM_NUMBER
vars.purpose: Default E.164 sender. A send without an explicit `from` fails with 'TELNYX_FROM_NUMBER is not configured'.

vars.name: TELNYX_API_BASE_URL
vars.purpose: Override the Telnyx API base URL.

vars.name: CONVEX_URL
vars.purpose: Deployment URL for local scripts and telemetry. Not read by Convex functions.

vars.name: RANK_AUTH_TOKEN
vars.purpose: Clerk session token for the calling identity. Local tooling never mints identities; without it authenticated operations fail closed.

vars.name: PORT
vars.purpose: Mock server port. Not read by Convex functions.
